theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_ga_lc_local_bilipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (g : Euclid m → Euclid k) (D : Set (Euclid m)) (ε : ℝ) (w₀ : Euclid m), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g D → 0 < ε → w₀ ∈ D → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball w₀ r ⊆ D ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball w₀ r, ∀ y ∈ ball w₀ r, (1 - ε) * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ x - fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ y‖ ≤ ‖ι x + ι' (g x) - (ι y + ι' (g y))‖ ∧ ‖ι x + ι' (g x) - (ι y + ι' (g y))‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ x - fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ y‖
